name: Milliam
source:
Department of Electrical Engineering; Striped squirrel

An undergrad squirrel who mistook 'master' of electrical engineering as a sort of kung fu master of electricity.

A student who wishes to become a lightning squirrel. It seems the romantic notions of the Therio lead quite a number of talented students down regret-filled paths.
